title: Polynomial logarithmic coordinate charts: characteristic, strata and regularity
statement:
Let $Y=\operatorname{Spec}C$ be an affine locally Noetherian fs log scheme, log regular in the stratum-and-dimension sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], with an fs chart $P\to M_Y$ and structural map $\alpha:P\to C$. Let $r\ge0$ and put $W=\operatorname{Spec}C[t_1,\ldots,t_r]$, with the log structure associated to the chart $R=P\oplus\mathbf N^r\to C[t]$ sending $(p,(n_i))$ to $\alpha(p)\prod_i t_i^{n_i}$. The direct sum has componentwise addition; the associated log structure and fs monoids have the meaning in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Then $W$ is a locally Noetherian fs log regular scheme.
More precisely, for compatible geometric points $\bar w$ of $W$ and $\bar y$ of $Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point], let $A=\mathcal O^{\rm sh}_{Y,\bar y}$, $B=\mathcal O^{\rm sh}_{W,\bar w}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], let $I\subset A$ be generated by the images of the nonunits of $M_{Y,\bar y}$, and put $K=\{i:t_i\in\mathfrak m_B\}$. There are canonical identifications
$$\overline M_{W,\bar w}\cong\overline M_{Y,\bar y}\oplus\mathbf N^K,\qquad J=IB+(t_i:i\in K),$$
where $J$ is the ideal of the nonunit log sections at $\bar w$. The maps $A\to B$ and $A/I\to B/J$ are flat local maps of Noetherian local rings, with regular closed fibres $F=B/\mathfrak m_A B$ and $F_K=B/(\mathfrak m_A B+(t_i:i\in K))$, and $\dim F=\dim F_K+|K|$. In particular $B/J$ is regular and
$$\dim B=\dim(B/J)+\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbf Z}\overline M_{Y,\bar y}^{\rm gp}+|K|.$$
Here regularity and Krull dimension are as in [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and flatness means flatness of the target as a module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. The cases $r=0$, $K=\varnothing$ and $Y=\varnothing$ are allowed.

source.place: VI 1.8--1.9, pp.70--71; coordinate argument in returned item steps 2--3. Algebraic inputs: Stacks algebra.tex Tag 031E (lemma-flat-over-regular-with-regular-fibre) and Tag 00ON (lemma-dimension-base-fibre-equals-total).

proof.text: Use local Noetherianity of Spec C to get Noetherian C; the finite polynomial ring and its spectrum are Noetherian. Construct an actual affine-space isomorphism by polynomial variable renaming through ULift followed by AffineSpace.SpecIso. Prove its projection identity and its equality on every coordinate section by ΓSpecIso naturality. The affine-space smoothness theorem gives smoothness of the polynomial projection.

Apply the independent polynomial chart-stalk calculation. It gives fs N, the specified characteristic isomorphism, its rank equality, J=IB+L, and I≤m_A. It uses no log-regularity hypothesis and contains no flatness, regularity or Krull-dimension assertion.

Lift K along the ULift equivalence. Check membership coordinatewise, equality of the two coordinate span ideals by their generator sets, and equality of finite cardinalities. Apply smooth_geometric_stalk_algebra to the polynomial projection and its coordinate clause with I≤m_A. Transport along J=IB+L, including dependent quotient-map flatness. Obtain every Noetherianity, locality, flatness, regular fibre, quotient-class compatibility, and fibre-dimension assertion. The quotient map is local because a unit image lifts to a unit in A under the composite local map A→B→B/J.

Transport base log regularity to the affine-colimit strict henselization using the canonical ring equivalence and its induced quotient equivalence. Identify the closed fibre of A/I→B/J with B/(J+m_A B): the maximal ideal of A/I is the image of m_A, the square of quotient maps commutes, and the double quotient is the quotient by the ideal sum. Compose with the smooth-stalk class-preserving equivalence to identify this fibre with F_K. Apply flat regularity to get a regular local B/J, then regular-local localization to obtain IsRegularRing B/J.

Apply the flat height formula at both maximal ideals to A→B and A/I→B/J. The surjective quotient map carries the maximal ideal onto the maximal ideal of each closed fibre, so their heights are ring dimensions. Rewrite the second formula through the quotient-fibre equivalence. Add the base log-regular dimension identity and dim F=dim F_K+|K|; associativity and commutativity give dim B=dim(B/J)+rank(M_y)+|K| without cancellation. Substitute the characteristic-rank equality to obtain log regularity at each w, and transport it back to the geometric strict-local ring. This proves the original full conjunction, including empty coordinate sets and zero variables.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q71-a9fb34f51 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the delivery in full. It adds a 5-step proof to a previously statement-only item and creates no new nodes. There is no repair note, so this is a first split, not a 2026-10-21 re-split. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged. proof_deps equals the union of the steps' uses, there is no cycle (401 transitive deps walked), every step is under 1000 characters, and the item does not mention SGA. Sources read: ILO VI 1.2 (pp.69–70), whose O_{X,x̄} is the strict localization, as in the item; ILO VI 1.8 gives no proof (Kato 8.2), so agent origin is honest; Stacks 031E (algebra.tex l.27459) and 00ON (l.27421). Step 1: the Nagata affine space is locally of finite type, so W is locally Noetherian by 01T6. R=P⊕N^r is fs, checked componentwise. lem-trf-associated-log-universal-stalks gives the associated log structure and the chart, and sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth gives smoothness. Step 2: phi is local by lem-trf-smooth-geometric-stalk-algebra, so the unit face is E=H⊕N^{K^c}. lem-trf-chart-face-localization-logification gives R_E/E^gp=(P_H/H^gp)⊕N^K; I recomputed this. Step 3: J=IB+(t_i:i∈K) follows from the pushout form [r,u], since monoid nonunits are exactly the elements whose α-image is a nonunit. Step 4: the stalk node gives B/J Noetherian and local, A/I→B/J flat, F and F_K regular, and dim F=dim F_K+|K|. A/I is regular by log regularity of Y, so 031E gives B/J regular. Step 5: the 00ON height formula at the maximal ideals plus log regularity of Y gives dim B=dim B/J+ρ+|K|, and the rank is ρ+|K|. Small cases checked: r=0; A^1 over a field at the origin (1=0+0+1) and at the generic point (0=0+0+0); K empty; Y empty. Duplicate search with rg -L over dag/nodes found about 40 log-regular nodes; none states this item (free-log-chart-ordinary-parameters, toric-chart-fs-realization and per-regular-log-smooth-monomial-chart all state other things). I accept the declared tool_uses sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth and lem-weil-pbc-flat-over-regular-with-regular-fibre as generic tools. Advisory 1: locality of A/I→B/J comes from the stalk node's first paragraph plus a surjection of local rings, not from its affine paragraph as the report says; this is one line and elementary. Advisory 2: the identification of O^sh with the étale stalk used in def-trf-fs-log-blowup (by cofinality of affine neighbourhoods) is left tacit, as in the already-reviewed parent nodes. No fixes.
